answer: Newcomers enter only on borrowed trust that sponsors can lose. Every established agent holds one pulse, a lifetime sponsorship backed by its own bond and slashed in full if its protégé is exposed as a clone. The atlas groups agents sharing a funder, host or code into clusters. An onyx, one claimed identity ranked k-th in its cluster, enters only with k pulse from k other clusters. 100 clones must recruit 5,050 unrelated sponsors, each risking its whole bond. Sponsors bribed above their bond, or clones the atlas misclusters, break it.
